thread:
incident-bot: PAGER — GPU pool 'primary-east1' at 98% utilization; request queue > 5k; autoscaler reporting errors. https://ops.redwood/internal/inc/2201234567
reza (oncall): seeing the page. i'm on it. paging maria and ben. tagging customers list for initial impact assessment.
maria (infra): on phone. pulling autoscaler logs now. can someone confirm if any recent deploys touched the pool config?
ben (sre): no deploys in last 2 hours from release pipeline. metrics show sharp increase in incoming qps ~07:12 UTC.
julia (platform): @reza we have cross-region steer available, but need to ensure variant compatibility. primary-east1 serves model: gpt-redwood-3b/q4_0. fallback pool in eu1 has q4_0 and q4_1 variants — q4_1 may produce slightly higher latency. OK to route %?
reza (oncall): prioritize availability. start 25% reroute to eu1 immediately, then iterate. @kai please validate model compatibility.
kai (api-prod-eng): quick check: model binary matches but kv-cache sharding differs; fallback will be cold-warm for a subset. Expect 80-120ms added tail latency. fine to proceed.
ben (sre): autoscaler errors: `scale_up failed: quota_exceeded (requested 12 GPUs, available 4)` — looks like cloud quota preventing scaleup. logs: ```
[2026-03-15T07:13:02Z] autoscaler: request_scale delta=+12 target=primary-east1
[2026-03-15T07:13:08Z] provider_api: error code=QuotaExceeded message="Insufficient GPUs in region"
[2026-03-15T07:13:09Z] autoscaler: falling back to best-effort, queue_length=5224
```
maria (infra): confirmed provider quota limit. i've raised a CloudOps request but that's multi-hour. we need to mitigate at the routing layer.
rohit (customer-ops): FYI customers affected so far: AcmeCorp (prod), MarketAI (staging->prod). Acme seeing 500s and long queues. currently toggling from support.
chris (support): Acme reported spike at 07:14 UTC. sent status to account team. they asked about SLA credit.
incident-bot: reroute job started — id=reroute-2201234567-1, plan: from=primary-east1,to=eu1,percent=25; progress updates in thread.
ben (sre): applying temporary token-based ingress throttle to reduce head-of-line pressure. command: ```
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood/api/limits -d '{"scope":"primary-east1","rate":1200}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'
``` will cap new sessions.
reza (oncall): do it. prefer graceful throttle over dropping.
maria (infra): throttle applied. new session rate now ~1.2k/s. queue rate growth slowed; queue length now 4.1k.
kai (api-prod-eng): reroute job reports 25% shifted; eu1 pools accepting traffic. instance cold starts visible. tail latency for routed requests ~140ms for smallest flows, some 300-400ms for long contexts.
julia (platform): increasing reroute to 45% to relieve pressure. doing in 10% steps.
incident-bot: reroute update id=reroute-2201234567-1 progress=45%
ben (sre): autoscaler still blocked in primary-east1 but queue dropping steadily. need to watch for secondary overload. monitor eu1 utilization.
maria (infra): eu1 trending up but within capacity. starting to pre-warm additional nodes in eu1 (manual provisioning) to avoid cascade.
rohit (customer-ops): emailing impacted customers with ETA and temporary mitigation details. requesting list of impacted endpoints and top request hashes for noise reduction.
chris (support): Acme confirmed partial recovery after reroute. they still see slower responses but not timeouts.
reza (oncall): good. set incident severity P1 -> still impacting paying customers but mitigated. assign oncall handoff: @maria will shadow for next hour and then hand to ben for post-incident analysis.
ben (sre): filing quick timeline and capturing logs (`/ops dump queue_metrics --from=07:00 --to=07:30 > /tmp/queue-2201234567.log`). also creating a temporary rule to prefer eu1 for new incoming sessions for the next 2 hours.
julia (platform): created routing override config: ```
routing.override.primary-east1 = 0.55
routing.override.eu1 = 0.45
activation = immediate
``` pushed to control plane id=cfg-2201234567-override.
incident-bot: incident state — mitigated (routing changes + throttle); oncall owners: maria, ben; postmortem required.
reza (oncall): notes for postmortem: root cause: unexpected burst + provider GPU quota preventing autoscaler. failure mode: queue growth + head-of-line leading to elevated tail latencies and 5xx. mitigation: routing spillover, ingress throttle, manual pre-warm in fallback region. action items: (1) request quota increases in primary-east1 (ops), (2) automate cross-region pre-warm when queue > 2k, (3) add clearer autoscaler alert for quota_exceeded, (4) customer communication template.
rohit (customer-ops): will coordinate SLA notes and follow-ups with accounts. collecting affected customer list now.
maria (infra): handing oncall to ben at 08:00 UTC. leaving routing override for 2h. will open cloud quota SR and link in postmortem doc.
chris (support): sending closure update to Acme and MarketAI now.
reza (oncall): closing the page for immediate escalation. will reconvene in postmortem. great job team. :thumbsup:
